利用通道移除和浴模型对照，将 p2 主要归因于退相位、p3 及以上主要归因于弛豫，且该能级依赖归属在所考虑浴模型间保持稳定。
直接检验最近邻 RWA 相干驱动截断并在占据数 80 关断时给出 p2(RWA)/p2(full)=0.905、p3(RWA)/p3(full)=0.759，同时识别被遗漏的宇称允许非最近邻电荷矩阵元，并区分裸基与缀饰基 beyond-RWA 扩展的零驱动表现。

title: Finite-Time Thermodynamic Routing in an Anharmonic Collective Quantum Otto Engine
summary: The Gibbs state determined by a thermal reservoir does not determine how a working medium approaches it or how fluctuations accumulate over repeated cycles. We exploit this kinetic freedom in an anharmonic collective quantum Otto engine. A longitudinal interaction separates neighboring Dicke transition frequencies without changing their collective matrix elements, allowing passive spectral shaping to route finite-time transport among edges with different heat costs while preserving the contact Gibbs states. Exact edge-current identities and repeated-cycle counting statistics link this routing to mean work, hot heat, and intercycle work correlations. At fixed thermal-contact exposure, structured reservoirs can increase both mean work and long-time squared precision; equal-work controls distinguish these gains from uniform relaxation-rate changes. The useful regime is mesoscopic, bounded by spectral resolution and physical contact time. An equal-cooling example and a full-spin local-noise study test the mechanism beyond ideal engine operation, the latter retaining a one-cycle precision gain despite spin-sector mixing. In a six-transmon dressed-spectrum model, passive microwave filters at fixed integrated coupling achieve equal mean work with shorter thermal contacts, corresponding to higher contact-time-normalized output, and with long-time squared precision comparable to that of the fastest sampled flat reference. The transition pathways selected by a passive reservoir thus provide a control variable for finite-time performance and accumulated work fluctuations that is independent of thermal equilibrium.

AI.abstract_zh: 由热库决定的吉布斯态并不决定工作介质如何趋近该态，也不决定在重复循环中涨落如何累积。我们在一个非谐集体量子奥托热机中利用这种动力学自由度。纵向相互作用将相邻的 Dicke 跃迁频率分开，而不改变它们的集体矩阵元，从而使被动谱整形能够在具有不同热成本的边之间路由有限时间输运，同时保持接触时的吉布斯态。精确的边电流恒等式和重复循环计数统计将这种路由与平均功、热端热量以及循环间功关联联系起来。在固定热接触暴露时间下，结构化热库可以同时提高平均功和长时间平方精度；等功对照将这些增益与均匀弛豫速率变化区分开来。有用区域是介观的，受谱分辨率和物理接触时间限制。一个等冷却示例和一个全自旋局域噪声研究在理想热机运行之外检验该机制，后者尽管存在自旋扇区混合，仍保留单循环精度增益。在一个六 transmon 缀饰谱模型中，固定积分耦合下的被动微波滤波器以更短的热接触实现相等平均功，对应更高的接触时间归一化输出，并且其长时间平方精度与最快采样的平坦参考相当。因此，被动热库所选择的跃迁路径为有限时间性能和累积功涨落提供了一个独立于热平衡的控制变量。
AI.conclusion: 作者总结认为，在集体奥托循环中，热库结构的影响源于跃迁能量与跃迁速率之间的分离：纵向相互作用分辨相邻 Dicke 跃迁而不改变集体矩阵元，局域细致平衡保持各热接触的吉布斯态，因此频率依赖热库可在不改变平衡态的情况下重新分配有限时间跃迁活动。边活动刻画跃迁重分配，而有符号边电流决定其对功和热的贡献；在固定热接触暴露下，结构化热库可同时提高平均提取功和长时间平方精度，且等输出比较表明这不等于均匀加速弛豫。该机制在制冷、全自旋局域噪声和六 transmon 缀饰谱模型中进行了检验；在所研究的六 transmon 模型中，固定积分耦合的被动微波滤波器在等平均功下把热接触从 10.55 μs 缩短到 8.48 μs，约对应单位热接触时间功提高 24%，长时间平方精度与最快采样的平坦参考相当。作者指出可用谱控制范围受谱分辨率和物理接触时间限制，并呈介观窗口；完整器件功率还需计入孤立冲程和热库切换时间。
innovations: 利用纵向相互作用分辨相邻 Dicke 跃迁频率而保持集体矩阵元不变，使被动谱整形可在不同热成本的边之间路由有限时间输运，同时保持接触吉布斯态。
建立精确的边电流恒等式和重复循环计数统计，将谱路由与平均功、热端热量及循环间功关联联系起来。
展示在固定热接触暴露下，结构化热库可同时提高平均功和长时间平方精度，且该增益不同于均匀弛豫速率变化，从而把跃迁路径作为独立于热平衡的有限时间控制变量。

title: Certifying quantum code and circuit distances at scale
comment: 73 pages (18 pages main text, 55 pages Supplementary Information), 8 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/Fanerst/tropidist
summary: Code and circuit distances characterize how strongly quantum error correction suppresses logical errors and guide code comparisons, schedule choices and resource estimates. Yet many published distances are only upper bounds from heuristic searches. Here, we express both distances as tropical partition functions and evaluate them with rank-based dynamic programming and weight-bounded search. Circuit reductions and relaxations shrink the problems, and proved lower bounds with explicit logical errors of matching weight certify exact values. On two benchmarks, our method certifies more instances than all other tested exact solvers combined. We certify distances for codes with up to 31,200 qubits, such as Google's modular hyperbolic codes, and for memory circuits with up to $8\times10^5$ fault mechanisms, such as those of high-rate Cornucopia codes. Our audit of 26 recent papers identifies overestimated distances and non-tight upper bounds in 10 papers, with a maximum discrepancy of at least eight. Certified distances also guide circuit design and show which defective chips remain usable. In particular, we certify circuit distance 16 for IBM's two-gross memory circuits with the standard schedule, not the assumed 18, whereas redesigned schedules reach 18 at one noisy cycle, at the cost of one more timestep per cycle. At 99.98% junction yield, keeping gross-code memory blocks with dead checks that are certified at distance 10 or more raises the estimated usable share from 53% for perfect blocks alone to 94% with an improved schedule.

AI.abstract_zh: 码距与线路距离刻画量子纠错抑制逻辑错误的强度，并指导码的比较、调度选择与资源估计。然而许多已发表的距离只是启发式搜索给出的上界。在这里，我们把这两种距离都表示为热带配分函数，并用基于秩的动态规划与权重有界搜索对其求值。电路归约与松弛可缩小问题规模，而带有匹配权重的显式逻辑错误所证明的下界能够认证精确值。在两个基准上，我们的方法所认证的实例数超过所有其他受测试精确求解器的总和。我们认证了多达 31,200 个量子比特的码的距离（例如 Google 的模块化双曲码），以及多达 $8\times10^5$ 个故障机制的存储电路的距离（例如高速率 Cornucopia 码的电路）。我们对 26 篇近期论文的审查发现，其中 10 篇存在被高估的距离与非紧的上界，最大偏差至少为八。认证的距离还可指导电路设计，并显示哪些有缺陷的芯片仍可使用。特别地，我们认证 IBM 的两个 gross 码存储电路在标准调度下的线路距离为 16，而非假定的 18；而重新设计的调度在一个噪声周期下可达到 18，代价是每个周期多一个时间步。在 99.98% 的结产率下，保留那些死校验被认证为距离 10 或以上的 gross 码存储块，可将估计的可用份额从仅保留完美块时的 53% 提高到采用改进调度时的 94%。
AI.conclusion: 作者指出，认证的精确距离把码或电路的距离从估计值变为可验证量，且可覆盖当前为硬件提出的电路规模；由于距离决定逻辑错误率的领头阶，这消除了码比较、资源估计与架构选择中的一个误差来源，例如 IBM 双 gross 存储指令被假定为距离 18，而认证结果为 16，并且证书会说明距离对哪个协议成立。当精确值仍不可及时，时间坍缩松弛给出廉价下界，从而以区间而非仅上界描述已知信息。达到该规模依赖多种精确算法的组合（各自代价依赖不同特征、可互补求解实例），但既宽又大距离的问题仍然代价高昂，作者提出分布式搜索、GPU 并行表更新、树状秩分解与自适应定界等降本方向。
innovations: 把码距与线路距离统一表达为热带配分函数，并用基于秩的动态规划与权重有界搜索求值，配合电路归约与松弛缩小问题规模。
以匹配权重的显式逻辑错误给出可证明的下界，从而认证距离的精确值，并在两个基准上认证的实例数超过所有其他受测试精确求解器之和。
将认证距离用于审查近期文献（发现 10 篇存在高估或非紧上界）并指导电路调度设计与缺陷芯片可用性评估。

title: Entropic measures of quantum information
comment: 84-page review article. Comments and suggestions very welcome
summary: Entropy has played a pivotal role in physics ever since its inception by Clausius in the early industrial age. Shannon ushered the concept into the information age by using it to describe fundamental limits of information processing, founding the field of information theory. Today, a fruitful interaction between information theory and physics is pushing our understanding of entropy forward. It has revealed, in particular, that no single notion of entropy suffices to capture all relevant properties of physical systems, making it necessary to consider a variety of entropic measures of quantum information, each with distinct features and uses. This review surveys these recent advances in a structured way, covering a comprehensive array of information measures, including Rényi and smooth entropies, together with their interrelations. Starting with a systematic characterization of entropies that motivates their definitions from natural physical principles, we discuss their applications ranging from quantum communication and cryptography to resource theories, thermodynamics, and many-body physics.

AI.abstract_zh: 自克劳修斯在工业时代早期提出熵以来，熵在物理学中一直发挥着关键作用。香农通过用熵描述信息处理的基本极限，将这一概念带入信息时代，并创立了信息论领域。如今，信息论与物理学之间富有成果的互动正在推动我们对熵的理解向前发展。尤其是，这种互动揭示出：没有任何单一的熵概念足以刻画物理系统的全部相关性质，因此有必要考虑多种量子信息的熵度量，每一种都具有不同的特征和用途。本综述以结构化方式梳理这些近期进展，全面覆盖一系列信息度量，包括Rényi熵和平滑熵及其相互关系。我们从对熵的系统性刻画出发，借助自然物理原则说明其定义的动机，进而讨论它们的应用，范围从量子通信和密码学到资源理论、热力学和多体物理。
AI.conclusion: 该综述的结论是：量子信息不存在单一足以刻画所有相关性质的熵概念，因而需要多种具有不同性质的熵度量；其公理化处理表明，散度与条件熵的许多性质可由自然物理原则刻画，而不同任务会选择不同信息度量。作者同时指出Rényi条件互信息的量子推广、多体量子关联的熵约束以及非可加性等问题仍未解决，因此这些结论主要是框架性梳理，而非新的实验或独立验证结果。
innovations: 以公理化方式系统刻画量子散度与条件熵的许多性质，并由自然物理原则说明熵定义的动机。
结构化梳理Rényi熵、平滑熵及多种信息度量，并给出其相互关系与较全面的包含所讨论散度的示意图。
将熵度量的公理化刻画与量子通信、密码学、资源理论、热力学和多体物理等应用联系起来。

title: Dualities in one-dimensional quantum lattice models: Lie groups, Schur-Weyl duality and symmetry breaking
summary: We present a systematic framework for gauging continuous symmetries, and show that the Schur-Weyl duality arises naturally as a realization of this construction with open boundary conditions. Restricting to compact Lie group symmetries, we construct dual models for one-dimensional quantum lattice models exhibiting those symmetries. We demonstrate that matrix product operators enable the explicit construction of intertwiners between the dual theories and their (non-invertible) symmetries. With closed boundary conditions, we can relate the full spectrum of these dual theories by considering all possible twisted boundary conditions.We illustrate how the Peter-Weyl transform appears when the duality acts on the boundary Hilbert space of a $G$-symmetric model. The presented framework generalizes previous work on dualities for unitary fusion category symmetric models. It exemplifies how dualities for both finite and continuous symmetries rely on the relation between a bond algebra and a representation of the symmetry in the lattice as double centralizers. We argue that dual non-invertible spontaneous symmetry breaking is the mechanism that underlies symmetric tensor network algorithms. We illustrate these results for $U(1)$- and $SU(2)$-symmetric quantum lattice models.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个用于规范化连续对称性的系统框架，并表明Schur-Weyl对偶作为该构造在开边界条件下的实现自然出现。限制到紧李群对称性，我们为表现出这些对称性的一维量子格点模型构造对偶模型。我们证明矩阵乘积算符使得能够显式构造对偶理论及其（非可逆）对称性之间的交织算符。在闭边界条件下，我们可以通过考虑所有可能的扭曲边界条件来联系这些对偶理论的完整谱。我们说明当对偶作用在$G$对称模型的边界希尔伯特空间上时Peter-Weyl变换如何出现。所提出的框架推广了先前关于幺正融合范畴对称模型对偶性的工作。它例示了有限和连续对称性的对偶如何依赖于键代数与格点中对称性表示作为双中心化子之间的关系。我们论证对偶非可逆自发对称破缺是对称张量网络算法背后的机制。我们以$U(1)$和$SU(2)$对称量子格点模型说明这些结果。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出一个用于规范化紧李群对称一维量子自旋链并构造对偶模型的框架：非可逆对称性与对偶算符可由矩阵乘积算符实现；开边界下该构造实现Schur-Weyl对偶及其变体，闭边界条件对应拓扑扇区，并可通过扭曲边界条件联系对偶理论谱；当对称性非可逆时，可由最小纠缠基态通过对偶对称算符得到其他基态，作者据此论证$\mathsf{Rep}(G)$对称对偶模型的自发对称破缺可解释对称张量网络方法的效率。适用范围为所讨论的一维紧李群对称格点模型及$U(1)$、$SU(2)$示例。
innovations: 提出针对紧李群对称一维量子格点模型的规范化与对偶构造框架，并在开边界条件下实现Schur-Weyl对偶及其变体。
给出用矩阵乘积算符显式构造对偶理论及其（非可逆）对称性之间交织算符的方法，并说明闭边界扭曲条件与对偶理论全谱的联系。
论证对偶非可逆自发对称破缺是对称张量网络算法有效性的底层机制，并以$U(1)$和$SU(2)$对称模型作示例。

title: Beyond Quantum Messages: Toward Quantum-Native Network Functioning
comment: Accepted manuscript for publication in Frontiers in Communications and Networks . This work has been funded by the European Union under Horizon Europe ERC-CoG grant QNattyNet ("Quantum-Native Communication Networks: from Quantum Message to Quantum Functioning"), n.101169850. Details at https://qnattynet.quantuminternet.it
summary: The Quantum Internet is commonly envisioned as a network that transports quantum states and distributes entanglement as the key resource underpinning distributed quantum applications. This view is necessary but incomplete if quantum phenomena are confined to what the network carries or manages, while network functionalities remain grounded predominantly in classical abstractions. This Perspective advances a broader thesis: quantum phenomena can also participate directly in the realization of network functionalities. We first establish the architectural baseline by introducing entanglement as a stateful network resource whose operational condition is non-locally distributed across remote nodes, evolves through manipulation or consumption, and degrades over time through decoherence. Its evolving state must therefore remain visible to the functionalities acting on it. We then move beyond resource visibility and use two mechanisms as proof points of a broader quantum-native functional design space: entanglement generation during propagation through coherent spatial-path superposition, and operational connectivity induced by shared entanglement that can depart from the physical graph. These examples show that paths, neighbors, or participating nodes may become operationally relevant in ways determined by quantum coherence and shared entanglement, rather than by physical connectivity alone. We identify Quantum Addressing as a transversal abstraction capable of representing such relations while complementing, rather than replacing, classical addressing and signaling. The resulting perspective broadens the Quantum Internet from transporting quantum information and distributing entanglement to exploiting quantum phenomena in network functioning, opening a coupled frontier spanning routing, forwarding, control, and functionality placement.

AI.abstract_zh: 量子互联网通常被设想为一种传输量子态并分发纠缠的网络，而纠缠是支撑分布式量子应用的关键资源。如果量子现象被限制在网络所承载或管理的内容之内，而网络功能仍主要建立在经典抽象之上，那么这一观点虽必要但不完整。本视角文章提出一个更广泛的论点：量子现象也可以直接参与网络功能的实现。我们首先通过将纠缠引入为一种有状态的网络资源来建立架构基线；该资源的运行条件非局域地分布在远程节点上，会通过操纵或消耗而演化，并会因退相干随时间退化。因此，其演化状态必须对作用于它的功能保持可见。随后，我们超越资源可见性，用两个机制作为更广泛的量子原生功能设计空间的证明点：在传播过程中通过相干空间路径叠加生成纠缠，以及由共享纠缠诱导的可偏离物理图的操作连通性。这些例子表明，路径、邻居或参与节点可能以由量子相干和共享纠缠而非仅由物理连通性决定的方式变得操作相关。我们识别出量子寻址作为一种横向抽象，能够表示此类关系，同时补充而非替代经典寻址与信令。由此形成的视角将量子互联网从传输量子信息和分发纠缠，拓展到在网络功能中利用量子现象，开辟了一个跨越路由、转发、控制和功能放置的耦合前沿。
AI.conclusion: 该文作为视角文章主张，量子互联网不应只被视为传输量子态和分发纠缠的网络，量子现象也可直接参与网络功能实现；为此需将纠缠视为状态非局域分布、可演化且会退相干的有状态资源，并以纠缠生成和共享纠缠诱导的操作连通性为例说明量子原生功能设计空间，同时提出量子寻址作为补充经典寻址与信令的抽象。上述结论属于概念性架构论点，摘要未给出实验验证或具体性能结果。
innovations: 提出量子现象可直接参与网络功能实现，而不只局限于网络传输或管理的量子信息。
以传播中相干空间路径叠加生成纠缠、共享纠缠诱导可偏离物理图的操作连通性，作为量子原生功能设计空间的证明点。
提出量子寻址作为表示此类量子关系的横向抽象，并强调其补充而非替代经典寻址与信令。

title: Recovery gates as a resource in repetition-code process tomography: exhaustive gate-optimal designs for three, five and seven qubits
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Companion to arXiv:2610.19779
summary: Process tomography built on stabilizer codes compares the logical channel of a repetition code with a reference channel, and the decoder that produces that channel is almost always fixed to the standard minimum-weight one. We ask how many physical single-qubit Pauli gates the decoder actually needs when the measurement basis is fixed---the constraint under which the count is a resource rather than a bookkeeping artefact. Exhaustive enumeration of every recovery design for $n=3$, $5$ and $7$ qubits, with rank decided by exact modular arithmetic at two primes, gives minimal counts of $0$, $1$ and $5$ gates, against $6$, $10$ and $14$ for first-order decoding and $6$, $50$ and $308$ for full minimum-weight decoding. The count depends only on how many sites are corrected and never on which, so the two halves of the design problem separate. Correcting more sites is not monotonically better: at $n=7$ full decoding loses three dimensions of rank, and under a calibration-residual floor the precision curve at $n=3$ is U-shaped. The three-gate design is $9.5$ times more precise than the standard six-gate decoder at the median of $40$ sampled working points, and more precise at every one of them ($1.8$ to $88$ times); the size of that factor belongs to the working point, the ordering does not. Reaching a $10$\,mrad rms error then costs $1.2\times10^{7}$ shots in $65$\,s on a current superconducting device at a well-conditioned point, while $n\ge5$ stays out of reach for conditioning reasons rather than gate-count reasons. Finally, the optimal designs are not covariant under chain reversal: they separate the mirror pair of arXiv:2610.19779 by $1.3\times10^{-3}$ while leaving the Jacobian at full rank.

AI.abstract_zh: 基于稳定子码的过程层析将重复码的逻辑信道与参考信道进行比较，而产生该信道的解码器几乎总是固定为标准的最小权重解码器。我们问，在测量基固定的情况下，解码器实际需要多少个物理单量子比特 Pauli 门——在这一约束下，门的计数是一种资源，而不是簿记上的产物。对 $n=3$、$5$ 和 $7$ 个量子比特的每一种恢复设计进行穷举枚举，并用两个素数上的精确模算术判定秩，得到最小计数分别为 $0$、$1$ 和 $5$ 个门，而一阶解码为 $6$、$10$ 和 $14$ 个门，完整最小权重解码为 $6$、$50$ 和 $308$ 个门。该计数只取决于校正了多少个位置，而从不取决于校正哪些位置，因此设计问题的两半彼此分离。校正更多位置并非单调更好：在 $n=7$ 时，完整解码损失三个秩维度；在校准残差底限下，$n=3$ 的精度曲线呈 U 形。三门外设计在 $40$ 个采样工作点的中位数处比标准六门解码器精确 $9.5$ 倍，并且在每一个工作点上都更精确（$1.8$ 至 $88$ 倍）；该倍数的大小取决于工作点，而排序不取决于工作点。随后，在当前某超导器件上于一个良态工作点达到 $10\,\mathrm{mrad}$ 均方根误差需要 $1.2\times10^{7}$ 次测量，耗时 $65\,\mathrm{s}$，而 $n\ge5$ 因条件化原因而非门数原因仍不可及。最后，最优设计在链反演下不是协变的：它们将 arXiv:2610.19779 中的镜像对分开 $1.3\times10^{-3}$，同时使 Jacobian 保持满秩。
AI.conclusion: 依据摘要，对 $n=3$、$5$、$7$ 重复码过程层析的穷举恢复设计表明，在固定测量基下解码器最少只需 $0$、$1$、$5$ 个物理单量子比特 Pauli 门，且门数只取决于校正位置数而不取决于具体位置；校正更多位置并非单调更优；三门外设计在 $40$ 个采样工作点上均比标准六门解码器更精确，但该优势大小随工作点变化。摘要还报告在当前超导器件良态工作点达到 $10\,\mathrm{mrad}$ 均方根误差需 $1.2\times10^{7}$ 次测量、$65\,\mathrm{s}$，$n\ge5$ 受条件化原因限制，以及最优设计在链反演下不具协变性。上述结论适用于该文研究的重复码过程层析、固定测量基及所述采样与校准条件，尚需独立验证。
innovations: 对 $n=3$、$5$、$7$ 量子比特的所有恢复设计进行穷举枚举，并给出固定测量基下门数最优设计的最小门数为 $0$、$1$、$5$。
表明解码器门数只取决于校正位置数而非具体位置，使设计问题的两半分离，并揭示校正更多位置并非单调更优。
给出三门外设计在 $40$ 个采样工作点上均优于标准六门解码器，并指出最优设计在链反演下不具协变性。

title: Testing Gravitationally-Induced-Entanglement with Massive Particles and Quantum Clocks
summary: We present an experimental proposal to test whether gravity can entangle a levitated particle with an array of quantum clocks. By harnessing the collective interaction between a micrometer-scale particle and an array of ultra-precise nuclear clocks, our scheme offers a conceivable path to observing gravitationally mediated entanglement with quantum clocks in the laboratory. Crucially, this setup will probe a genuinely relativistic effect one that requires the contribution of internal clock energy to active gravitational mass and cannot arise from the Newtonian interaction between fixed masses. Therefore, observing this entanglement would provide evidence for the quantised nature of active gravitational mass -- which has not been tested in any prior experiment -- rather than for spatial coherence of fixed masses,which is routinely tested in matterwave interferometers

AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个实验方案，用于检验引力能否使一个悬浮粒子与一组量子钟发生纠缠。通过利用微米尺度粒子与一组超精密核钟之间的集体相互作用，我们的方案为在实验室中用量子钟观测引力介导的纠缠提供了一条可设想的路径。关键在于，该装置将探测一种真正的相对论效应——它需要内部钟能量对主动引力质量的贡献，而不能由固定质量之间的牛顿相互作用产生。因此，观测到这种纠缠将为主动引力质量的量子化性质提供证据——此前任何实验都未检验过这一点——而不是为固定质量的空间相干性提供证据，后者已在物质波干涉仪中被常规检验。
AI.conclusion: 摘要仅提出实验方案，未给出实验结果或明确结论。作者预期，若在实验室中观测到悬浮微米粒子与超精密核钟阵列之间的引力介导纠缠，将为主动引力质量的量子化性质提供证据，而非检验固定质量的空间相干性；该主张尚待实验验证。
innovations: 提出用悬浮微米粒子与超精密核钟阵列的集体相互作用检验引力介导纠缠的实验方案。
方案针对需要内部钟能量贡献于主动引力质量的相对论效应，而非固定质量间的牛顿相互作用。
作者称观测该纠缠可为主动引力质量的量子化性质提供证据，而该性质此前未在实验中得到检验。

title: Recalibration-Aware Optimization of ZEFOZ Operating Points in $^{167}\mathrm{Er}^{3+}:\mathrm{Y}_2\mathrm{SiO}_5$ for Quantum Memories
summary: Erbium-doped solids like $^{167}\mathrm{Er}^{3+}:\mathrm{Y}_2\mathrm{SiO}_5$ have properties that make them suitable for quantum-network memories, however, their unquenched effective electronic spin causes rapid magnetic decoherence. Operating at Zero First-Order Zeeman (ZEFOZ) points allows us to mitigate this, where we evaluate the ZEFOZ landscape for Site-2 $^{167}\mathrm{Er}^{3+}$ by incorporating a full-Hessian spin-Hamiltonian treatment with the anisotropic magnetic-field covariance derived from the native $^{89}\mathrm{Y}$ crystal lattice directly. Operating-point screening criteria were adopted to devise a Pareto-optimal frontier of four transition pairs to balance modeled Y-only magnetic pure-dephasing lifetimes ($T_{φ,Y}^{(2)}$) against microwave control authority. The $ε_{14}\leftrightarrowε_{15}$ transition exhibits the longest modeled Y-bath-induced quadratic pure-dephasing time, $T_{φ,Y}^{(2)}>2.2\times10^5~\mathrm{s}$, while the $ε_{12}\leftrightarrowε_{13}$ transition stood out, achieving a Rabi frequency coefficient of $1.248 \times 10^5~\mathrm{Hz/mT}$. An assumption-based Hamiltonian-uncertainty analysis demonstrates that while uncompensated deviations shift the ZEFOZ condition away from its nominal magnetic-field coordinate, the shifted operating points can be recovered via numerical vector-field recalibration. The Pareto-optimal coordinates were mathematically recovered for all sampled Hamiltonian perturbations, and the $84.1^{\mathrm{st}}$-percentile field relocations ranged from $10.95$ to $27.97~\mathrm{mT}$. The intended operation near $10~\mathrm{mK}$ must be taken into account for the suppression of Er-induced spectral diffusion through electronic-spin polarization, while the extended Y-bath pure-dephasing timescales also remain conditional on the adopted temporal-correlation model.

AI.abstract_zh: 诸如 $^{167}\mathrm{Er}^{3+}:\mathrm{Y}_2\mathrm{SiO}_5$ 的掺铒固体具有使其适合作为量子网络存储器的性质，然而其未被淬灭的有效电子自旋会导致快速的磁退相干。在零一阶塞曼（ZEFOZ）点工作可缓解这一问题；其中，我们通过将全 Hessian 自旋哈密顿量处理与直接由原生 $^{89}\mathrm{Y}$ 晶格导出的各向异性磁场协方差相结合，评估了 Site-2 $^{167}\mathrm{Er}^{3+}$ 的 ZEFOZ 景观。采用工作点筛选标准，构建了由四个跃迁对组成的 Pareto 最优前沿，以在建模的仅由 Y 引起的磁纯退相位寿命（$T_{\phi,Y}^{(2)}$）与微波控制能力之间取得平衡。$\epsilon_{14}\leftrightarrow\epsilon_{15}$ 跃迁表现出最长的建模的 Y 浴诱导二次纯退相位时间，$T_{\phi,Y}^{(2)}>2.2\times10^5~\mathrm{s}$；而 $\epsilon_{12}\leftrightarrow\epsilon_{13}$ 跃迁尤为突出，达到 $1.248\times10^5~\mathrm{Hz/mT}$ 的拉比频率系数。基于假设的哈密顿量不确定性分析表明，虽然未补偿的偏差会使 ZEFOZ 条件偏离其标称磁场坐标，但偏移后的工作点可通过数值矢量场重校准恢复。对于所有采样的哈密顿量扰动，Pareto 最优坐标均在数学上得到恢复，第 $84.1^{\mathrm{st}}$ 百分位的场重定位范围为 $10.95$ 至 $27.97~\mathrm{mT}$。针对通过电子自旋极化抑制 Er 诱导的光谱扩散，必须考虑在约 $10~\mathrm{mK}$ 附近的预期运行；同时，延长的 Y 浴纯退相位时间尺度仍取决于所采用的时间关联模型。
AI.conclusion: 作者评估了 Site-2 $^{167}\mathrm{Er}^{3+}:\mathrm{Y}_2\mathrm{SiO}_5$ 量子存储器的运行景观：结合全 Hessian 自旋哈密顿量、原生 $^{89}\mathrm{Y}$ 晶格的各向异性磁场协方差以及显式时间关联模型，得到在仅由 Y 核浴导致的纯磁退相位寿命与微波控制能力之间权衡的四跃迁对 Pareto 最优前沿；$\epsilon_{14}\leftrightarrow\epsilon_{15}$ 的建模 Y 浴二次纯退相位时间为 $2.2\times10^5~\mathrm{s}$，$\epsilon_{12}\leftrightarrow\epsilon_{13}$ 的拉比频率系数为 $1.248\times10^5~\mathrm{Hz/mT}$。哈密顿量不确定性分析显示，对所采样的每个参数扰动均可数值恢复四个 Pareto 最优跃迁，第 $84.1^{\mathrm{st}}$ 百分位的场重定位范围为 $10.95$ 至 $27.97~\mathrm{mT}$。这些结果给出可供实验矢量场搜索的物理筛选工作点；相关仅由 Y 引起的纯磁退相位寿命估计仍取决于所采用的核浴动力学以及在预期毫开尔文温度下对 Er 诱导光谱扩散的抑制。
innovations: 将全 Hessian 自旋哈密顿量处理与直接由原生 $^{89}\mathrm{Y}$ 晶格导出的各向异性磁场协方差结合，用于评估 Site-2 $^{167}\mathrm{Er}^{3+}:\mathrm{Y}_2\mathrm{SiO}_5$ 的 ZEFOZ 景观。
构建了在建模的仅由 Y 引起的磁纯退相位寿命与微波控制能力之间权衡的 Pareto 最优四跃迁对前沿。
通过基于假设的哈密顿量不确定性分析，展示了对所有采样扰动数值恢复 Pareto 最优坐标，并给出第 $84.1^{\mathrm{st}}$ 百分位场重定位 $10.95$ 至 $27.97~\mathrm{mT}$ 的结果。

title: Disorder-blind Mpemba acceleration of quantum state preparation
summary: Using the strong Mpemba effect to accelerate relaxation by initial-state design requires suppressing the slowest mode, which typically needs prior knowledge of the system. However, in disordered systems, this mode is sample-dependent, so a fixed preparation generally retains a slow-mode overlap. We show that a ``blind'' preparation, designed from the clean chain without knowledge of the disorder realisation or its distribution, can start farther from stationarity yet overtake a reference in typical samples of a dephased disordered XX chain. It requires only the chain geometry and the particle number. At strong dephasing, the density dynamics maps to a resistor chain, and an exact inverse-generator identity links the residual overlap to the spatial resistance profile. We find two distinct thresholds: a finite mean resistance suffices for diffusion, but the residual overlap decays as $L^{-1/2}$ with chain length $L$ only when the resistance variance is finite; rare weak links slow this decay. We predict the fraction of samples in which the blind preparation wins, which is an ensemble-level measure of its reliability. Finite-size calculations support both scaling regimes with interactions at strong dephasing. We give preparation circuits and a density readout for the residual overlap.

AI.abstract_zh: 利用强 Mpemba 效应通过初态设计加速弛豫，需要抑制最慢模式，而这通常需要关于系统的先验知识。然而，在无序系统中，该模式依赖于具体样本，因此固定的制备一般会保留慢模式重叠。我们表明，一种“盲”制备——基于干净链设计，且不知道无序实现或其分布——可以在退相位无序 XX 链的典型样本中从更远离定常态的初态出发，却超过一个参考制备。它只需要链的几何结构和粒子数。在强退相位下，密度动力学映射为电阻链，并且一个精确的逆生成元恒等式将残余重叠与空间电阻分布联系起来。我们发现两个不同的阈值：有限的平均电阻足以实现扩散，但残余重叠仅在电阻方差有限时才随链长 $L$ 以 $L^{-1/2}$ 衰减；稀少的弱链接会减慢这种衰减。我们预测盲制备获胜的样本比例，这是其可靠性的系综层面度量。有限尺寸计算支持在强退相位下带相互作用时的两种标度区间。我们给出了制备电路以及残余重叠的密度读出。
AI.conclusion: 摘要表明，在退相位无序 XX 链中，仅依赖链几何与粒子数的盲制备可在典型样本中超过参考制备；强退相位下密度动力学可用电阻链描述，残余重叠衰减由电阻方差是否有限决定，有限尺寸计算支持相应标度行为。该结论限于所研究的无序 XX 链与强退相位情形，尚未见正文结论章节。
innovations: 提出无需无序实现或其分布知识的盲制备，仅需链几何和粒子数。
在强退相位下建立密度动力学到电阻链的映射，并给出将残余重叠与空间电阻分布联系的精确逆生成元恒等式。
识别出扩散与残余重叠衰减的两个不同阈值，并预测盲制备获胜的样本比例，同时给出制备电路和密度读出。

title: Quantum enhanced beam displacement estimation: sensitivity limits, optimal probes, and measurement schemes
summary: We investigate the ultimate sensitivity limits for measuring small transverse beam displacements and identify optimal strategies that attain them, using the framework of mode parameter estimation. We contrast two families of states with different resource constraints, using Hermite-Gauss and Laguerre-Gauss mode pairs. First, for fixed total photon number states, the optimal state is identified and we show that it asymptotically approaches a rotated NOON state. The sensitivity bound is compared to that of an asymptotically optimal pure Gaussian state with fixed average photon number. Finally, we propose concrete measurement schemes using the method of moments and show that the twin-Fock state may provide a viable alternative to the rotated NOON state for this task. Our work provides a broader benchmark for developing practical strategies for spatial sensing at the quantum limit.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们利用模式参数估计框架，研究测量微小横向光束位移的最终灵敏度极限，并确定达到这些极限的最优策略。我们使用厄米-高斯和拉盖尔-高斯模式对，对比两类具有不同资源约束的态。首先，对于固定总光子数的态，我们确定了最优态，并证明它渐近趋近于旋转的NOON态。我们将该灵敏度界与具有固定平均光子数的渐近最优纯高斯态的灵敏度界进行比较。最后，我们提出使用矩方法的具体测量方案，并表明双福克态可能为该任务提供一种可行的替代旋转NOON态的方案。我们的工作为在量子极限下开发空间传感的实际策略提供了更广泛的基准。
AI.conclusion: 作者在无损、小位移、双模且固定总光子数或固定平均光子数的纯高斯态等设定下，利用模式参数估计给出横向光束位移幅度估计的最终灵敏度极限与最优初始态：固定N时量子Fisher信息随光子数二次增长，显示可达海森堡标度，最优态渐近为旋转NOON态；固定平均光子数的渐近最优纯高斯态（旋转基下单模压缩态）可比固定N理论极限约好2倍，源于光子数涨落。作者还提出基于矩的测量方案，并在固定N与压缩真空情形下给出量子增强标度。上述结论限于无损、小位移、双模分析，未涵盖损耗、噪声、方向估计或多参数情形。
innovations: 在固定总光子数、无损、小位移的双模设定下，确定最优初始态及相应量子Fisher信息，并给出随光子数二次增长的灵敏度上界。
表明大光子数下该最优固定N态渐近趋近旋转NOON态，并表明固定平均光子数的渐近最优纯高斯态可把灵敏度相对固定N理论极限提高约2倍。
提出基于矩的具体测量方案，并指出双福克态可能作为旋转NOON态在该任务中的可行替代。

title: DiffSequence-Q: Diffusion Design with Quantum Assistance for Biologically Active Proteins
summary: Designing protein sequences that satisfy both secondary structure requirements and solubility targets remains challenging. We present DiffSequence-Q, a hybrid multinomial diffusion model conditioned on secondary structure at each residue and a continuous solubility target. To introduce quantum auxiliary supervision during training, we employ a quantum neural network (QNN) or quantum Kolmogorov-Arnold network (QKAN) as an auxiliary solubility prediction head over shared Transformer representations. The auxiliary prediction loss is jointly optimized with the diffusion objective, allowing quantum auxiliary supervision to influence the learned denoising model. Once trained, protein sequences are generated entirely through classical reverse diffusion. On the CATH benchmark, DiffSequence-Q achieved the highest secondary structure recovery among the four evaluated models for complete sequence generation. Evaluation with a separately trained solubility prediction model showed that the best QNN and QKAN configurations achieved mean predicted solubility scores 14.0% and 22.7% higher than the multilayer perceptron (MLP) baseline, respectively. Experimental characterization further demonstrated biological activity across three distinct protein families. Selected defensins exhibited pronounced inhibitory activity against Aspergillus niger, while xylanases and short-chain dehydrogenases exhibited substantial enzymatic activity. Together, these results support DiffSequence-Q as a framework for integrating structural requirements and solubility targets in protein generation, with experimentally demonstrated biological activity.

AI.abstract_zh: 设计同时满足二级结构要求和溶解度目标的蛋白质序列仍然具有挑战性。我们提出 DiffSequence-Q，一种混合多项扩散模型，以每个残基的二级结构和连续的溶解度目标为条件。为了在训练期间引入量子辅助监督，我们采用量子神经网络（QNN）或量子 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（QKAN）作为辅助溶解度预测头，作用于共享的 Transformer 表示之上。辅助预测损失与扩散目标联合优化，使量子辅助监督能够影响学习到的去噪模型。训练完成后，蛋白质序列完全通过经典反向扩散生成。在 CATH 基准上，对于完整序列生成，DiffSequence-Q 在四个被评估模型中取得了最高的二级结构恢复率。使用单独训练的溶解度预测模型进行评估显示，最佳的 QNN 和 QKAN 配置分别取得了比多层感知机（MLP）基线高 14.0% 和 22.7% 的平均预测溶解度得分。实验表征进一步证明了三个不同蛋白质家族中的生物活性。所选防御素对黑曲霉表现出显著的抑制活性，而木聚糖酶和短链脱氢酶表现出可观的酶活性。总之，这些结果支持 DiffSequence-Q 作为在蛋白质生成中整合结构要求和溶解度目标的框架，并具有实验证明的生物活性。
AI.conclusion: DiffSequence-Q 将以蛋白质二级结构和溶解度为条件的多项扩散与联合训练的量子性质预测器相结合；QNN 和 QKAN 预测器分别引入光子干涉特征和结构化傅里叶响应，联合监督更新共享的去噪表示。在 CATH 基准上，该模型在四个被评估模型的完整序列生成中取得最高的二级结构恢复率；在溶解度评估中，最佳 QNN 和 QKAN 配置的平均预测溶解度得分高于经典 MLP 参考。使用光子量子硬件响应进行训练时，QNN 实验使用 TuringQ Gen3 光子量子计算机上的直接电路测量，QKAN 实验使用由先前测得的光子量子概率校准的可微响应映射；两者在前 10 个 epoch 均降低了总训练损失和溶解度训练损失，支持使用硬件衍生响应的混合优化。功能与生化实验表明，模型生成的所选防御素、木聚糖酶和短链脱氢酶具有生物活性，将评估扩展到抗菌活性和酶活性。总体而言，这些结果支持 DiffSequence-Q 作为在功能性蛋白质设计中整合结构约束和溶解度目标的框架；实验验证目前限于所选蛋白质家族，未来研究将扩展到可溶性蛋白表达的定量产量、折叠稳定性和难处理靶标的结构表征。
innovations: 提出以每个残基的二级结构和连续溶解度目标为条件的混合多项扩散蛋白质序列生成框架。
将 QNN 或 QKAN 作为共享 Transformer 表示上的辅助溶解度预测头，并与扩散目标联合优化。
在训练中引入光子量子硬件响应，包括直接电路测量或由实测概率校准的可微响应映射，用于混合优化。

title: Polynomial-time classical simulation of boson and fermion sampling under thermal loss
summary: Sampling experiments are a leading approach to demonstrating quantum computational advantage, yet their robustness to experimental noise is not completely understood. We develop a common framework for classical simulation of boson and fermion sampling under thermal loss, including pure loss. For Fock-state boson sampling, Gaussian boson sampling with fixed uniform squeezing, and fermion sampling with magic inputs, we obtain polynomial-time sampling at inverse-polynomial total variation error, for any fixed nonzero overall loss rate, and with high probability over Haar-random interferometers. A milder flatness assumption on the ideal output distribution suffices for quasipolynomial-time simulation without Haar randomness. With constant thermal loss per layer, the same flatness assumption gives polynomial-time simulation at logarithmic depth. Our bounds for Fock-state boson sampling cover both dilute and saturated regimes and become stronger near full input filling: when only a bounded number of input modes are empty, the noisy output for Haar-random interferometers converges, as the number of modes grows, to a distribution independent of the interferometer.

AI.abstract_zh: 采样实验是展示量子计算优势的一条主要途径，但其对实验噪声的鲁棒性尚未被完全理解。我们建立了一个统一框架，用于在热损耗（包括纯损耗）下对玻色采样和费米采样进行经典模拟。对于福克态玻色采样、具有固定均匀压缩的高斯玻色采样，以及具有魔术输入的费米采样，我们在任意固定的非零总损耗率下，以逆多项式总变差误差实现多项式时间采样，并且对 Haar 随机干涉仪以高概率成立。对理想输出分布施加更温和的平坦性假设，就足以在没有 Haar 随机性的情况下实现准多项式时间模拟。在每层恒定热损耗下，同样的平坦性假设可在对数深度给出多项式时间模拟。我们对福克态玻色采样的界覆盖稀薄和饱和两种区域，并在接近完全输入填充时变得更强：当只有有界数量的输入模式为空时，随着模式数增长，Haar 随机干涉仪的含噪输出收敛到一个与干涉仪无关的分布。
AI.conclusion: 作者的结论表明，在 Haar 随机干涉仪下，即使处于平均探测粒子数与模式数成正比的实验相关区域，要实现超多项式量子优势也需要损耗率随系统增大而趋于零；探测到恒定比例的输入粒子不足以证明这种优势。其保证依赖于输出分布的平坦性假设，未解决峰值分布受噪声影响的问题；且多项式运行时间不意味着有限尺寸实验可在实践中被模拟，因为界随损耗率倒数指数增长，最优经典采样成本与匹配下界仍待确定。
innovations: 建立统一框架，在热损耗（含纯损耗）下经典模拟玻色采样与费米采样。
对福克态玻色采样、固定均匀压缩的高斯玻色采样和魔术输入费米采样，证明固定非零总损耗下以逆多项式总变差误差进行多项式时间采样，且对 Haar 随机干涉仪高概率成立。
在平坦性假设下给出准多项式时间模拟，并在每层恒定热损耗时于对数深度实现多项式时间模拟，且福克态界覆盖稀薄与饱和区域并在接近完全填充时增强。

title: Room-Temperature Quantum Emission from Boron Nitride Nanotubes
summary: Quantum information systems such as quantum key distribution and quantum communications require bright, high-purity, stable sources of single photons to act as carriers of quantum information. As such, methods for obtaining single photon emitters (SPEs) in solid-state devices capable of articulating with quantum photonic circuits are a necessary obstacle that must be overcome. Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) flakes have been extensively studied as a host material for SPEs, though working in two dimensions is accompanied by engineering complexity. However, dimensionality can be reduced through the implementation of boron nitride nanotubes (BNNTs). Here we investigate the potential of BNNTs as room-temperature SPEs using confocal photoluminescence microscopy and Hanbury Brown-Twiss interferometry. Quantum emitters were found in BNNTs spanning the entirety of the visible spectrum, including spectral regions where SPEs within hBN have not been reported. Furthermore, each tube was found to possess multiple SPEs at varying emission wavelengths along the length, exhibiting lifetimes as fast as 0.5 ns, which is about two-fold faster than the fastest hBN SPEs. Additionally, we demonstrate that surface passivation/coating mitigates blinking events, therefore increasing the emitter stability. Thus, BNNTs can function as a single structure supporting a variety of multiwavelength SPE sources, while maintaining a compact radius of ~25 nm, making them ideally suited for deterministic placement and integration within nanophotonic devices such as waveguides and interferometric filters.

AI.abstract_zh: 量子信息系统，如量子密钥分发和量子通信，需要明亮、高纯度、稳定的单光子源作为量子信息的载体。因此，在能够与量子光子电路衔接的固态器件中获得单光子发射器（SPE）的方法，是必须克服的必要障碍。六方氮化硼（hBN）薄片已被广泛研究作为SPE的宿主材料，但在二维体系中进行工作伴随着工程复杂性。然而，通过采用氮化硼纳米管（BNNT）可以降低维度。在此，我们利用共聚焦光致发光显微术和Hanbury Brown-Twiss干涉术研究BNNT作为室温SPE的潜力。我们在BNNT中发现了覆盖整个可见光谱的量子发射器，包括hBN中尚未报道过SPE的光谱区域。此外，发现每根管沿长度方向在不同发射波长处具有多个SPE，其寿命可快至0.5 ns，比最快的hBN SPE快约两倍。另外，我们证明表面钝化/涂层可减轻闪烁事件，从而提高发射器稳定性。因此，BNNT可作为支持多种多波长SPE源的单一结构，同时保持约25 nm的紧凑半径，使其非常适合确定性放置并集成到波导和干涉滤光片等纳米光子器件中。
AI.conclusion: 摘要报告BNNT可作为室温单光子发射器，覆盖可见光谱，单根管沿长度方向具有多个不同发射波长的SPE，寿命最快约0.5 ns，表面钝化/涂层可减少闪烁并提高稳定性，约25 nm的半径有利于确定性放置和纳米光子器件集成；由于未提供正文结论章节，上述结论仅基于原始摘要，适用范围限于摘要所述实验观察。
innovations: 在BNNT中观察到覆盖整个可见光谱的室温量子发射，包括hBN中尚未报道SPE的光谱区域。
发现每根BNNT沿长度方向具有多个不同发射波长的SPE，寿命快至0.5 ns，约为最快hBN SPE的两倍。
展示表面钝化/涂层可减轻闪烁事件并提高发射器稳定性。

title: Quantum Knowledge Distillation: State-of-the-art, Applications and Open Problems
summary: Knowledge distillation transfers predictions, representations, or other supervisory information between learning models and is increasingly investigated in quantum machine learning. Its applications extend beyond compression to cross-architecture transfer, circuit approximation, distributed learning, and classical deployment of models trained using quantum-derived supervision. This survey reviews these approaches using two complementary classification axes: teacher-student configuration and the role of quantum resources in the distillation process. Quantum-inspired methods are discussed separately from methods that simulate quantum computations classically or execute them on quantum hardware. We explain how measurement probabilities, expectation values, classical readouts, state overlaps, and circuit-level objectives support different transfer mechanisms. We then critically assess the presented results against baseline design, execution conditions, uncertainty, and resource costs. The evidence shows that distillation can improve selected quantum students, but benefits are task- and architecture-dependent, and several studies find negligible gains or even performance degradation. Evaluations on physical quantum hardware remain limited, with some testing individual quantum components rather than complete learning pipelines. Heterogeneous protocols and incomplete resource reporting prevent general conclusions about practical quantum advantage. We identify priorities for controlled benchmarking, noise-aware learning, reproducible evaluation, and efficient transfer between quantum and classical models.

AI.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏在学习模型之间迁移预测、表示或其他监督信息，并日益在量子机器学习中得到研究。其应用已超越压缩，扩展到跨架构迁移、电路近似、分布式学习，以及将由量子衍生监督训练得到的模型进行经典部署。本综述使用两个互补的分类轴回顾这些方法：师生配置以及量子资源在蒸馏过程中的作用。量子启发方法与被经典模拟或在实际量子硬件上执行的量子计算方法分开讨论。我们解释测量概率、期望值、经典读出、态重叠和电路级目标如何支持不同的迁移机制。随后，我们依据基线设计、执行条件、不确定性和资源成本对所述结果进行批判性评估。证据表明，蒸馏可以改进选定的量子学生模型，但收益依赖任务和架构，且若干研究发现收益可忽略甚至性能下降。物理量子硬件上的评估仍然有限，一些工作测试的是单个量子组件而非完整学习流程。异构协议和不完整的资源报告阻碍了关于实际量子优势的一般性结论。我们识别出受控基准测试、噪声感知学习、可复现评估以及量子与经典模型之间高效迁移等优先事项。
AI.conclusion: 根据所提供的综述材料，量子知识蒸馏在部分量子学生模型上可带来改进，但其效果依赖任务与架构，部分研究报告无收益甚至性能下降；物理量子硬件评估有限，且协议异质、资源报告不完整，尚不足以对实际量子优势作一般性结论。该综述覆盖经典到量子、量子到量子、量子到经典及量子增强蒸馏，并列举图像分类、目标检测与3D视觉、强化学习、自然语言处理、组合优化、无线通信、网络安全和医疗保健等应用，但这些应用属于综述范围，而非本文独立验证。
innovations: 提出区分经典到量子、量子到量子、量子到经典三类师生配置方向，并将量子增强蒸馏作为由蒸馏过程中量子资源使用定义的互补类别。
系统梳理量子知识蒸馏的应用与方法，并依据基线设计、执行条件、不确定性和资源成本对结果进行批判性评估。
识别受控标准化评估、硬件感知蒸馏、可复现评估以及更多样蒸馏机制等未来优先方向。

title: Provable circuit-level thresholds for non-abelian topological phases
summary: We provide an explicit scheme to realize a quantum memory in any 2D non-chiral topological order. For this, we construct syndrome extraction circuits based on the Turaev-Viro path integral as well as a classical algorithm for decoding on the fly. We prove that our scheme has a threshold under a local stochastic circuit-level noise model and discuss how to generalize it to implement topological logical gates.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们提供了一个显式方案，可在任意二维非手性拓扑序中实现量子存储器。为此，我们基于 Turaev–Viro 路径积分构造了症候提取电路，以及一种用于实时解码的经典算法。我们证明，在局域随机电路级噪声模型下，我们的方案具有阈值，并讨论了如何将其推广以实现拓扑逻辑门。
AI.conclusion: 作者针对任意二维非手性内禀拓扑相给出了具体的症候提取电路和经典解码器，用于容错地维持量子存储器；并证明对于任意 ε-有界（局域随机）电路级噪声模型，存在阈值 ε_*，当 ε<ε_* 时逻辑错误率随系统尺寸 L 呈准拉伸指数衰减。该方案基于时空 Turaev–Viro 路径积分，每个时间步测量症候、运行全局经典解码算法并施加校正；解码器利用聚类算法处理截至该时间步记录到的噪声所致任意子世界线的时空历史。作者还概述了将路径积分构造和解码方案推广到涉及计算任意子和其他拓扑缺陷的逻辑操作，描述了相应的电路与解码器修改、对缺陷演化的因果性约束，并勾勒了阈值论证的适配方式；但这些推广在节选中仍属概述。
innovations: 提出基于 Turaev–Viro 路径积分的症候提取电路与实时经典解码器，可在任意二维非手性拓扑序中实现量子存储器。
证明在局域随机电路级噪声模型下该方案存在阈值，且逻辑错误率随系统尺寸呈准拉伸指数衰减。
概述将路径积分构造和解码方案推广到涉及计算任意子及拓扑缺陷的拓扑逻辑操作。
